name: Splunk - Analytics-Based & Statistical Detection
command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 | bin _time span=1h | stats count as NetworkConnections by _time, Image | streamstats time_window=24h avg(NetworkConnections) as avg stdev(NetworkConnections) as stdev by Image | eval isOutlier=if(NetworkConnections > (avg + (0.5*stdev)), 1, 0) | search isOutlier=1
description: SPL analytics and statistics-based detection patterns for identifying anomalies without relying on static signatures. Covers beaconing detection with streamstats, long command line detection, abnormal cmd.exe frequency, high DLL loading per process, and transaction-based repeated process detection.
source: CDSA Module 05: Understanding Log Sources & Investigating with Splunk
notes:
=== Beaconing Detection (C2 Periodic Network Connections) ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3
  | bin _time span=1h
  | stats count as NetworkConnections by _time, Image
  | streamstats time_window=24h avg(NetworkConnections) as avg stdev(NetworkConnections) as stdev by Image
  | eval isOutlier=if(NetworkConnections > (avg + (0.5*stdev)), 1, 0)
  | search isOutlier=1

  How it works:
    1. bin: group into hourly buckets
    2. stats count: how many connections per image per hour
    3. streamstats: rolling 24h average + stdev per process
    4. eval isOutlier: flag if count > avg + 0.5*stdev (sensitive threshold)
    5. search isOutlier=1: return only anomalies
  → Catches C2 beaconing that spikes above a process's own baseline
  → Tune the stdev multiplier (0.5 = sensitive, 2.0 = conservative)

=== Long Command Lines (Encoded/Obfuscated PowerShell) ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1
  | eval len=len(CommandLine)
  | table User, len, CommandLine
  | sort - len
  → Sorts by longest command line first; encoded PowerShell is extremely long

=== Abnormal cmd.exe Execution Frequency by User ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 Image="*cmd.exe"
  | stats count by User
  | sort - count
  → Identify users with unusually high cmd.exe invocations
  → Baseline: compare against typical user behavior

  # With time bucketing for trend:
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 Image="*cmd.exe"
  | bin _time span=1h
  | stats count by _time, User
  | sort - count

=== High DLL Loading Per Process (Event 7) ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=7
  | stats count by Image
  | sort - count
  → Processes loading abnormally many DLLs may indicate reflective loading / injected implants

  # Focus on unsigned DLLs loaded by common processes:
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=7 Signed=false
  | stats count by Image, ImageLoaded
  | sort - count

=== Repeated Process Execution (Transaction-Based) ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1
  | transaction Image maxpause=5m
  | where eventcount > 10
  | stats count by Image
  | sort - count
  → Processes that start and stop repeatedly within a short window
  → Characteristic of loaders, stagers, or malware beaconing via process execution

=== Detect Processes Making Rare External Connections ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3
  | stats dc(DestinationIp) as unique_dest by Image
  | sort - unique_dest
  → Processes connecting to many unique IPs (scanning, data exfil, C2 rotation)

=== Rare Process + Network Connect Combination ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" (EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3)
  | transaction Image startswith=eval(EventCode=1) endswith=eval(EventCode=3) maxspan=30s
  | stats count by Image
  | sort count
  → Rare processes: those that start and immediately make a network connection
  → Sorted ascending: rarest at top

=== Baseline vs. Deviation: Network by Process ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3
  | stats count by Image, DestinationPort
  | eventstats avg(count) as avg_count stdev(count) as stdev_count by DestinationPort
  | eval deviation=abs(count - avg_count) / (stdev_count + 0.001)
  | where deviation > 3
  | table Image, DestinationPort, count, avg_count, deviation
  | sort - deviation
  → Identify process+port combos that are statistically unusual

=== General Analytics Workflow ===
  1. Start broad: stats count by X — find outliers visually
  2. Add time bucketing (bin) to see temporal patterns
  3. Apply streamstats for rolling baselines against own history
  4. Use eval + stdev to score and filter anomalies
  5. Enrich: table with CommandLine, User, host for context
  6. Save as alert: convert to Saved Search with cron schedule
